behavior: The Clients page follows the app's list page rules (full width, toolbar search, table with initials avatars, the shared empty and no-match states, form pages with breadcrumbs), and long choices (countries, saved clients) are searchable selects from the kit
acceptance: The kit has a ComboboxField (a select with a search box: typing filters labels without regard to accents, arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes) shown on /kit with its states; every country choice (billing details, saved client, invoice client) and the saved-client picker use it

/app/clients is full width like Invoices: search on the left of the toolbar and Add client at its end (beside the title on phones), a table with the client's initials avatar where a row opens the client, the shared empty state and Nothing matches; new and edit are pages under Clients with breadcrumbs, delete is in the edit page's More actions menu with a confirm dialog, and a toast only follows a save or delete that leaves the page
axe finds 0 serious or critical violations on the list, the form and the kit; 390 px phones have no sideways scroll on the list and the form
notes: 2026-10-16 review pass by reviewer: Independent review, two rounds. Fixed after round 1: long countries no longer squeeze names on phone rows; the search panel hangs from the field above its hint or error; client form pages laid out like New invoice (shared FieldGroup panels, More actions at the page's top right); Tab and mouse focus handling, aria-selected on the active row, unused props removed, kit error demo, accent-insensitive list search, ListToolbar without a filter leaves no gap, Clear search label, no 'gone' flash after delete, avatar fallback, structure and design docs. Left: accent-folding helper written twice (kit copy is private), list search not in the URL.
